decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting builds directly on the firm's existing marine electrical and lighting knowledge, enabling it to interpret early results and improve the product.
Spring-balanced desk lamp is distant from the firm's core marine/industrial lighting capabilities, limiting its ability to learn from early market feedback and develop the product further.
General interior lighting luminaire is closely related to the firm's lighting knowledge and the G2 version indicates prior experience, supporting learning and product improvement.
Pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics extends the firm's existing optical and lighting expertise, allowing it to assimilate early performance data and refine the product.
Marine HMI searchlight is highly aligned with the firm's searchlight and high-intensity lighting knowledge, facilitating interpretation of early results and ongoing development.
Marine searchlight is core to the firm's marine lighting capabilities, so early results can be readily understood and used to improve the product.
